Bug_Details:
Arguments to AutoValue constructor are in the wrong order AutoValue constructors are synthesized with their parameters in the same order
as the abstract accessor methods. Calls to the constructor need to match this
ordering.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the `create` method of the `User` class. The parameters were swapped, so the parameter `age` was passed as the `name` parameter, and the parameter `name` was passed as the `age` parameter. This caused the bug to be present in the generated code.
